Footer.privacyContent:
1. Data Controller

The controller of your personal data is Evoliq s.r.o., registered office at [address], ID: [ID].

2. What Data We Process

We process the following categories of personal data:

  • Identification data (name, surname, email, phone)
  • Data on the use of our services
  • Cookies and other analytical data

3. Purpose of Processing

We process your personal data for the purpose of:

  • Providing our services and products
  • Communicating with you regarding our services
  • Improving the quality of our services
  • Fulfilling legal obligations

4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process data based on:

  • Your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR)
  • Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
  • Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)

5. Retention Period

We retain personal data for the period necessary to fulfill the purpose of processing, but at least for the period required by legal regulations.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict processing, transfer data, and object. If you have any questions, contact us at [contact email].
Footer.gdprContent:
General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

GDPR is an EU regulation on personal data protection that came into force on May 25, 2018. It ensures uniform rules for personal data protection across the European Union.

Your Rights under GDPR:

  • Right of Access: You have the right to obtain information about what personal data we process about you.
  • Right to Rectification: You have the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Right to Erasure: You can request the deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
  • Right to Restriction of Processing: You can request restriction of processing of your data.
  • Right to Portability: You have the right to obtain your data in a structured, commonly used format.
  • Right to Object: You can object to the processing of your data.
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: If processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time.

How to Exercise Your Rights:

To exercise your rights, contact us at email: [contact email]

We will respond without undue delay, no later than 1 month after receiving the request.

Complaint to Supervisory Authority:

You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection (www.uoou.cz) if you believe that the processing of your personal data violates GDPR.
